notes.title: Update alpha v0.6.19
notes.content:
New features:
•	Implemented a new area: Abandoned Castle
Balance:
•	Buffed vanguards Harden skill
•	Made enemies in scorched caves stronger
•	Reworked Destroyer boss
•	It is now possible to drink potions while in the air
Fixes:
•	Fixed Bat enemy not doing damage
•	Fixed archers’ skills casting two times
•	Fixed active skill upgrades not resetting on a new game
•	Fixed sacrificing skill slot removing all items and skills from skill bar
•	Fixed sacrificing skill slot destroying equipped item in that slot
•	Fixed Hell Hound enemy dropping 0 stack items
•	Fixed one hidden chest missing loot table
•	Fixed Cyclone’s upgrade skill missing requirement
•	Fixed needing to save pending skill points to allocate the next one
•	Fixed air attack not working if holding controllers’ left analog stick up
•	Fixed random levels seed not resetting
•	Fixed lava caves random level infinite particles
•	Fixed render order issues in heart of the temple
